ContainerId.description: The identifier of a container: 12 to 64 lowercase hex digits, as the docker CLI prints it.

ContainerLabels.description: The labels a container carries: the job, the run and the experiment it belongs to.

experiment.description: The digest of the experiment: the value of the `candler.experiment` label.

job.description: The job the container belongs to: the value of the `candler.job` label.

run.description: The run the container belongs to, in its path form: the value of the `candler.run` label.

ContainerRole.description: The part a container plays in a run: `agent` or `gateway`.

oneOf.description: The container is the gateway the agent reaches its provider through.

Digest.description: A content digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

JobId.description: A job id: a `UUIDv7` in lowercase hyphenated form.

Marker.description: The value of `CANDLER_RUN` in a child's environment: an ASCII letter or digit, then letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`.

Timestamp.$comment: The pattern states the lexical form; a date or time that names no instant, such as month 13, and a fraction of more than nine digits are refused by the parser.
Timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp with an uppercase `T` and an explicit offset, `Z` or `±HH:MM`.

description: The record the supervisor writes for a container: its id, labels, creation time, image, role and spawn time, with the version marker `container-record/1` in `schema`.

created_at.description: When the container was created, as the container engine reports it.

image_id.description: The id of the image the container was created from.

labels.description: The labels the container was created with.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `container-record/1`.

spawned_at.description: When the supervisor spawned the container.

title: ContainerRecord
